developer_reply:
Thank's a lot for trying Habit It, Ricardo!
Me and my partner built this app with the goal to not limit users on core features such as how many habits you can add, for us this feature is very important to keep free, but to support this we had to restrict some personalization features for PRO users. For any ideas, mail us at support@thinkoutside.app

text: No option to mark how much time inverted into a habit vs the goal of the habit, and no option to mark that by doing it 5 times a week is enough without spefifying which days.
author: David Lago
developer_reply:
Hi David,

Thanks again for the feedback! Just wanted to let you know that we’ve added support for weekly goals in Habit It, so now you can set something like “5 times a week” without needing to choose specific days.

Thanks for your patience, and we hope Habit It works great for you now!

Paul, co-creator of Habit It 🚀
